reference.pathophysiology: Low-dose bupivacaine-fentanyl epidurals with combined-spinal options mobilise labour with fetal tracing while spinals with co-load phenylephrine and left tilt open sections; magnesium with platelet-airway caution spans preeclampsia, and crash apnoeic generals with TXA-massive transfusion rescue bleeds.
